# Disagreement Log — GTH_100

**Date:** 2026-03-17
**Saying:** 100
**Agents:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA

---

## Disagreements

| # | Verse | EMET | LOGOS | PNEUMA | Issue |
|---|-------|------|-------|--------|-------|
| 1 | 100 | "Caesar's men demand taxes" | "Caesar's agents are demanding taxes" | "Caesar's people are collecting taxes" | Tax collectors: men vs. agents vs. people; demand vs. collect |
| 2 | 100 | "Give Caesar what belongs to Caesar" | "Give to Caesar what is Caesar's" | "Give Caesar what belongs to Caesar" | Dative structure: give Caesar vs. give to Caesar |
| 3 | 100 | no dash | no dash | dash before third clause | Typographic emphasis on the surprising third element |

**Total disagreements: 3**

---

**Resolution:** SOPHIA adopts "Caesar's men demand taxes" (most literal), "Give Caesar what belongs to Caesar" (possessive construction), and no added dash (the text gives no extra emphasis on the third clause — the mystery stands equally with the other two).
